name: Zubu Nure no Ane Kasumi "Watashi no Mizugi ni Sonna Kitanai Mono, Shimikomasenaide!"
original_name: ズブ濡れの義姉・香澄「私の水着にそんな汚いもの、染み込ませないで！」
source:
Ryusuke belongs to the male swimming club. But one day, the club is forced to close down because of an accident. He asks Kasumi, his older step sister, not to close down, but she ignores it. After all, he joins the female swimming club to do chores. "I'll get even with you someday...." One day, he accidentally sees Kasumi masturbating in the club room....

[From ErogeShop]
